birth.note: Estimated based on his age at death (seventy or more years old).

death.note: He died in the month of Ramadan, leaving behind a young child.

relation.note: A cancelled duplicate entry (source 471923879121, $$$-ed) reads: "al-Ḥasan b. Amīr ʿAlī b. Sunqur Ḥusām al-Dīn Ibn Ghurlū — Ghurlū being an ancestor on his mother's side". The father is identified with ʿAlī b. Sunqur al-ʿAyntābī, naqīb al-jaysh (AIND-D05171); confirmed by editorial decision (Waka, 2026-08-10).
He was a neighbor of the author, al-Sakhāwī.

person.note: ハサン・ビン・グルルー、フサーム・アッディーン。我らの隣人。ヒジュラ暦886年ラマダーン月に70歳以上で没した。幼い子を遺した。彼はアミール・アリー・ビン・スンクルの息子である（「グルルー」は母方の先祖の名）。
Ḥasan b. Ghurlū, Ḥusām al-Dīn, our neighbor. He died in Ramaḍān in the year 886 AH, aged seventy or more, and left behind a young child. He was the son of Amīr ʿAlī b. Sunqur.
